problem:
The lifetime of a lithium-ion battery produced by a particular company is normally distributed with a mean of $\mu $ years and a standard deviation of $0.5$ years.
Additionally, $3%$ of batteries last less than $1.75$ years. Find the mean $\mu $, rounded to $2$ decimal places.

*Hint: A table of values of ${Φ}^{-1}(p)$ for different values of $p$ is given below, where $p=Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *

| $p$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ | $\,0.10\,$ | $\,0.15\,$ | $\,0.20\,$ | $\,0.25\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${Φ}^{-1}(p)$ | $\,-2.3263\,$ | $\,-1.8808\,$ | $\,-1.6449\,$ | $\,-1.2816\,$ | $\,-1.0364\,$ | $\,-0.8416\,$ | $\,-0.6745\,$ |

feedback.problem:
The lifetime of a fuse produced by a company is normally distributed with a mean of $\mu $ hours and a standard deviation of $1\,500$ hours. Additionally, $25%$ of the fuses have a lifetime lower than $7\,000$ hours. Find the mean $\mu ,$ rounded to the nearest hour.

*Hint: A table of values of ${Φ}^{-1}(p)$ for different values of $p$ is given below, where $p=Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *

| $p$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ | $\,0.10\,$ | $\,0.15\,$ | $\,0.20\,$ | $\,0.25\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${Φ}^{-1}(p)$ | $\,-2.3263\,$ | $\,-1.8808\,$ | $\,-1.6449\,$ | $\,-1.2816\,$ | $\,-1.0364\,$ | $\,-0.8416\,$ | $\,-0.6745\,$ |
feedback.worked_solution:
Let $X$ represent the lifetime of a fuse. Then we have $X∼N(\mu ,1\,{500}^{2}),$  and we want to find the mean $\mu .$ 

We know that $P(X<7\,000)=0.25.$ First, we convert $X$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X<7\,000) & =0.25 \\ P(Z<\frac{7\,000-\mu }{1\,500}) & =0.25 \\ Φ(\frac{7\,000-\mu }{1\,500}) & =0.25 \\ \frac{7\,000-\mu }{1\,500} & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.25)\end{aligned}
$$

From the table, 

$$
{Φ}^{-1}(0.25)≈-0.6745.
$$

Finally then, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7\,000-\mu }{1\,500} & =-0.6745 \\ 7\,000-\mu  & =-1011.75 \\ \mu  & ≈8012\,\text{hours}\end{aligned}
$$
